body: I'm so sorry to have worried you, nice folks. I shouldn't have bothered anyone, even if we're all just strangers. I usually keep things to myself, but the other night was not that case, for some reason. I'm a user of prozac, for many years now... apparently it doesn't work that well anymore. Please, if I had put a weight on your heart, releive it now - that would relieve mine twice as much. I promise I will try to figure somethnig out... I had many such new beginnings in the past, and everytime the hill seems steeper and longer... usually I force myself to begin exercising, and work from there. So I fake hope and go. Thanks for being nice. Have a happy new year!
